description: This Dart source file defines the HospitalJobsScreen widget, which displays a list of hospital job posts and provides functionality to create new job posts via a dialog. It interacts with the hospital provider for state management and manages job postings within a Flutter application.

classes.name: HospitalJobsScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays a list of job posts with functionality to add new jobs and delete existing ones.

methods.name: showCreateJobDialog
methods.description: A static method that displays a dialog for creating a new job post, collecting input data, constructing a JobPost object, and invoking the provider to save it.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method that returns the widget tree, including instructions and a list of existing jobs, each with a delete button.
